shortDescription: A Perspective Shift addon: begin as a lone captive of a hostile faction. body:
# Perspective Shift - Captivity

An addon to **Perspective Shift** (`ferny.PerspectiveShift`). Hard depends on Perspective Shift and Harmony. Fully SFW. Optional soft-compat with your slavery/prison mods; nothing NSFW shipped or required.

## Concept
Play a single pawn (PS **Authentic**) held captive by a hostile faction in a real enemy settlement. Captors seize, carry, and abuse you; you resist with a struggle minigame. Pick locks to move, shed your restraints, lie low to lower their guard, then slip away into the wild.

## Verified in-game
Phase 1 start; the full seize + carry + struggle + escalation loop; the escape (Slip away -> Camp wilderness map).

## Core loop
- **Seize** (`JobDriver_SeizeCaptive`): captor carries you off, then a paused struggle minigame (`Dialog_Struggle`). Win = break free (escalation); lose = the action applies (Discipline / Harass / Sold / Organ harvest). Breaking free ramps resistStreak -> subdue, lethal at high streak + setting.

## Doors + lockpicking (new)
As a hostile-faction prisoner you cannot open captor doors (`Building_Door.PawnCanOpen` returns false, which also blocks pathing via `GenPath`). So:
- **Pick the lock** HUD button appears when you stand next to a closed captor door you can't open. Opens `Dialog_Lockpick`, an Oblivion-style pin minigame (3-5 pins by door strength; set each pin when the sweeping slider is over the sweet spot).
- **Suspicion while watched:** if a captor is within ~14 cells, a suspicion meter climbs with time and on misses; fill it and you are **caught** (heat to 100 + a captor seizes you). Unwatched, you can take your time.
- **Success** adds the door to a scribed picked-doors allowlist; a `Building_Door.PawnCanOpen` postfix then lets only the captive open/path that door (and it pops open on success). This is how you reach privacy to work restraints and lower heat.

## Escape loop
HUD buttons (always visible, no pawn-selection needed): **Work at your restraints** (struggle minigame, unwatched only, strips shackles then collar); **Slip away (X%)** (chance from heat + restraints + guards; success relocates you to a fresh vanilla `Camp` wilderness map, keeping the avatar on a real map so PS stays happy, and offers Settle/caravan; failure = caught + recapture). **Heat decays** ~2/in-game-hour when quiet, opening the window.

## Status HUD (`MapComponent_CaptivityHud`)
Over-map panel (opaque plate, left heat-ramp strip, one status ramp, Small font, sentence case): owner + status, Defiance bar, Watched bar, restraints, escape hint, and the Pick / Work / Slip buttons. Toggle in settings.

## Compat (`CaptivityCompat`, soft/guarded)
Slavery Overhaul (`SO_Brand` on sale + obedience -> temperaments), collar at capture (Simple Slavery Collars else vanilla; BDew skipped), Rimpsyche will (iron-willed break slower), RJW/RJW-SH compat-only (not yet live-audited). Plan: `_dev/PerspectiveShiftCaptivity/COMPAT_PLAN.md`.

## State + director
`GameComponent_Captivity` (captor, captive, status, obedience/heat, resistStreak, pickedDoorIds, scribed timers, kill-switch). `CaptivityDirector` schedules actions on an elapsed-time cadence; obedience via `ShiftObedience` (will-dampened).

## Status / risk
Lockpicking built + green, UNTESTED. Confidence ~70-75%: the `PawnCanOpen` patch is the standard gate for both pathing and opening; the main unknown is PS direct-movement interacting with the newly-openable door (vanilla door-approach logic + force-open should cover it).

## Debug actions
Force discipline / harass / sell / organ harvest, Pick nearest door, Brand, Fit collar, Obedience 0/100, Heat 0 + reset streak, Free, Dump state.

## Dependencies
Hard: Perspective Shift, Harmony. Optional soft: Slavery Overhaul, Rimpsyche, Karma, Simple Slavery Collars, RJW/RJW-SH (compat only).

## GitHub Backup
Repo: TBD. Create private `PerspectiveShift-Captivity` under Astryls once lockpicking + escape are verified together.
